note: PUBLICATION.md owns what may never be published. It says nothing about generated output, one host's harness, the work journal, or scratch, so those accumulated in the public tree unclassified and a newcomer reads them as product. This declares a surface for every tracked top-level path and the routes that must reach a reader. It grants nothing and changes no standing; scripts/sov_publication.py is the only thing that grades against it.

HUB.rule: The product a stranger clones. A newcomer route may name it.

HOST.rule: One host binding's harness, kept by owner choice. Must declare its host. A newcomer route must not present it as the product, and whether it stays public is owner-held.

DERIVED.rule: Generated from declared sources. Tracked only when a builder and a check both exist as files, so a stale copy fails rather than misinforming a reader.

JOURNAL.rule: The append-preserving record of work done. Kept deliberately; never routed to as documentation.

SCRATCH.rule: Work in progress kept in the tree by choice. Must declare what retires it.

LOCAL.rule: The operator's machine only. Tracking one of these is a defect, not a preference.

routes.why: A stranger arriving at a public repository needs the licence that says whether they may use it, the index of the commands the node is operated through, how to contribute, and what is deliberately absent.
A cold model must reach the portable profile and the current standing without reading a stale founding prompt first.
Three adapters and three bindings exist and no document says how to add one, so the system is extensible only by the person who built it.

entrypoint_index.why: The sov_* command-line entrypoints are the node's whole operable surface and README.md names one of them. An entrypoint absent from the index is unreachable by anyone who did not write it.

retired.why: Instructs an agent to copy a ZIP seed into an empty directory, verify locked digests and create the founding commit. That operation completed on day one. It sorts first alphabetically at the repository root, so a cold agent listing the tree reads it before anything current.
retired.disposition: Carry the still-true parts into AGENTS.md, then mark the file RETIRED or remove it.
